title: Northlake Fintech - discovery
_demo_note: Structural aid only. Quotes come from the transcript, never from this summary.
summary: Discovery with Northlake Fintech's platform team. Current state is page-everyone because service ownership is unclear, plus a hand-built MTTR dashboard nobody trusts. Two concrete blockers to signing: on-call mapping must survive a group rename, and the schedule must be exportable as CSV for compliance. They evaluated Beaconline and found the postmortem workflow bolted on.
next_step: Yes or no on both blockers by Thursday.
